meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

copy.tagline: 统筹多个 AI 工人,分步交接并监督任务执行进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把复杂任务拆给多个 AI 工人,并保持过程可控可见。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate several AI workers to split tasks and oversee step-by-step progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage several AI assistants and want visible, controlled delegation across them.

howto.what: Claude 会作为协调者指挥多个受监督的 Orca worker:派发任务、收发线程消息、阻塞式问答、等待 worker_done 或升级信号,并按任务 DAG 与决策门推进。真正可用的操作指南由 orca 二进制按版本提供。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化多智能体协调时触发,例如任务分发、阻塞式问答、等待 worker 完成信号等;若只是完整所有权交接或普通终端控制,则交给 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 把这几个子任务分派给不同 worker,等全部完成后汇总
say.note: 会按任务 DAG 派发并等待完成信号

say.text: 向那个 worker 提问,并阻塞等它的回复
say.note: 走阻塞式 ask/reply 流程

say.text: 有个 worker 卡住了,查它的状态并升级处理
say.note: 会读取终端并进入 escalation 等待

howto.what_en: Claude acts as coordinator over supervised Orca workers: dispatching tasks, threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, waiting for worker_done/escalation, and following task DAGs and decision gates. The guide comes from the orca binary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need structured multi-agent coordination, e.g. task dispatch, blocking ask/reply, or waiting on worker_done signals. For plain handoffs or terminal control, use orca-cli.

say_en.text: Dispatch these three subtasks to separate Orca workers and wait for them all
say_en.note: Dispatches a task DAG and waits for completion signals

say_en.text: Ask that worker a question and block until it replies
A worker looks stuck — check its status and escalate
say_en.note: Reads the terminal and enters an escalation wait
